{{Quote|I assure you, I was designed by one of the foremost minds in the Republic&mdash;Doctor Boab Deduun.|M1-4X|<ref name="Built for the Job" />}}
''' Boab Deduun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who designed the prototype [[M1-4X]] Advanced War Droid for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Advanced Development Laboratories]] and the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thanks to Doctor Deduun, I can understand the importance of our fight, and the extent of the threats we face. And I can fight harder for it.|M1-4X|<ref name="Built for the Job" />}}
[[File:M1-4X_Advanced_War_Droid.png|thumb|200px| M1-4X Advanced War Droid]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]],<ref name="Built for the Job" /> Boab Deduun was the protégé of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], the chief designer of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Advanced Development Laboratories]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> An esteemed doctor in his own right by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Deduun designed the [[M1-4X]] Advanced War Droid<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|companions|m1-4x|M1-4X}}</ref> under the codename [[Project Ignition]], but the project was scrapped on account of problems with the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[M1-4X's power core|power core]]. However, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] approached Deduun and convinced him to restart the project using Tavus' own funds, claiming that its cancellation had been a front to keep the project secret.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Deduun finished the droid in his [[Boab Deduun's lab|lab]] at a classified location, instilling a deep love of the Republic and a fierce hatred of the Empire in M1-4X before Tavus took the completed droid to use for his own ends.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boab Deduun was first mentioned on [[the Holonet]] section of the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in the entry for the [[Republic trooper|Trooper]] companion M1-4X.<ref name="Holonet" />
